reply.critique: Every ranked listing is open to a non-union NYC performer and the first four state pay (a starting $125 per show, $200 to $800 a day, $100 per gig, a $700 stipend), with dates and locations. The Equity-only auditions pay more but are limited to union members, so leaving them out is right. The set leans toward acting; Roulette is the only music call, and a couple of other rolling music calls (Culture Lab LIC, FABnyc) are comparable, so nothing clearly better was left out.
